description: Frame a buy/refi-now vs wait recommendation. Combines recent rate movement (direction + magnitude over 1w/2w/4w) with break-even sensitivity on the borrower's loan to return a forward 'lock now' vs 'wait' lean, the bps swing that would change the call, and the cost of waiting. Use for 'should I lock now or wait for rates to drop?' questions. Distinct from get_rate_delta (raw historical deltas only) — this adds a forward recommendation. Not a rate forecast.

current_rate.description: Borrower's existing or quoted rate %, enables refi-now framing

loan_amount.description: Loan amount in dollars — drives break-even sensitivity

rate_shift_bps.description: Hypothetical bps move if waiting; default derived from observed movement

term_months.description: Loan term in months (default 360 for mortgage)

name: assess_buy_timing

assumed_defaults.description: Inputs the caller did not supply that were filled in with defaults. State these explicitly to the user, since they drive the numbers.

closing_costs.description: Closing costs in dollars assumed because the caller did not supply them.

rate_shift_bps.description: Rate shift in basis points assumed for the wait scenario because the caller did not supply one.

since.description: Lookback window assumed for the rate-movement comparison because the caller did not supply one.

term_months.description: Loan term in months assumed because the caller did not supply one.

break_even.description: How the cost of waiting nets out against the hoped-for saving.

break_even_months.description: Months of the projected monthly saving needed to repay the cost of waiting.

net_cost_of_waiting.description: Net dollars waiting would cost. A negative value means waiting would save money on these assumptions.

payment_swing_per_25bps.description: Dollars the monthly payment moves for every 25 basis point change in rate; a quick sensitivity yardstick.

confidence.description: Qualitative confidence in the recommendation — 'high', 'medium', or 'low' — driven by how much data and how large the margin is.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

movement.description: How the market has moved over the comparison window, from the earlier snapshot to now.

direction.description: Direction of the median move over the window: 'up', 'down', or 'flat'.

median_delta_pct.description: Change in the median APR over the window, in percentage points (0.25 = 25 basis points). Negative means rates fell.

now.description: Current market snapshot (min, median, max APR in percent, offer count, and as-of timestamp).

then.description: Market snapshot at the start of the window, for comparison against `now`. Its `count` is often much smaller because history is retention-bounded.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools that would deepen this answer; offer them as next steps, not as results.

tool.description: Name of the follow-up MCP tool to call next.

why.description: One-line reason this follow-up tool would be useful given the current result.

note.description: A caveat about the DATA behind this call, not an error — e.g. limited rate history for that product and state, so the answer is a snapshot rather than a timing judgement. Present only when such a caveat applies; carry it into any answer.

now.description: The best deal available today, for comparison against waiting.

best_lender.description: Credit union publishing that best rate.

best_rate.description: Best published rate in percent available right now for this product and state.

monthly_payment.description: Monthly principal-and-interest payment in dollars at that best rate.

product_type.description: Loan or deposit category this result covers, e.g. 'mortgage', 'auto_loan', 'heloc', 'savings'.

rationale.description: Plain-English explanation of why this recommendation was reached; safe to quote to the user as the reasoning.

state.description: Two-letter US state code the result is scoped to (e.g. 'CA'). Null means the result was not filtered by state.

wait_scenario.description: A what-if for waiting, built from the caller's assumed rate shift. It is a sensitivity test, not a forecast.

assumed_shift_bps.description: Rate change in basis points the wait scenario assumes (-25 = rates fall a quarter point). Supplied by the caller, not predicted.

monthly_delta.description: Change in monthly payment in dollars if the assumed shift happens; negative means waiting would be cheaper per month.

projected_monthly_payment.description: Monthly payment in dollars at the projected rate.

projected_rate.description: Rate in percent implied by applying that shift to today's best rate.

window.description: Lookback period used for the comparison, expressed as a short duration string such as '4w', '90d', or '180d'.
